imageRegistry.caption: Axial CECT shows calcified gallstones in the gallbladder. Gallstones may be of variable attenuation with calcified gallstones easiest to appreciate on CT or radiography.

imageRegistry.caption: Axial CECT shows prominent calcification of the gallbladder wall , compatible with a porcelain gallbladder. The association between porcelain gallbladder and gallbladder carcinoma is now considered somewhat debatable.
